summary: iter89 — Frontend-only verification of V1 crypto polish (A): Live Preflight card, redesigned Active Exit card, and the tightened Research wizard copy on BOTH web and mobile. WEB Exit Engine (bottom-nav-workspace → ENGINE sub-tab): live-preflight-card renders with preflight-mode='PAPER · simulation', preflight-connection='Connected · kraken', preflight-size='$150 / trade' + soft-cap note 'Above ~$75 — keep small (~$50) for first live tests' (correctly triggered because normal_lot_usd=150 > SOFT_CAP_USD=75), preflight-kill='Active' with preflight-kill-action visible for owner. Kill toggle exercised end-to-end: click → 'Trading STOPPED / Resume' → click again → 'Trading Active / Kill-switch' (kill switch left FALSE, verified by GET /api/settings). No BACK-to-PAPER shown because is_live=false (correct). ACTIVE EXIT card header reads 'ACTIVE EXIT · GLOBAL DEFAULT'; active-exit-overrides present and shows the two per-strategy chips 'squeeze · Fixed-% Stop' and 'hunter · ATR Trailing Stop' (matches spec). active-exit-edit button opens the Modify flow with exit-stepbar (Scope → Method → Configure → Deploy) — verified. WEB Research (bottom-nav-research → research-subtab-validate): stepped through the wizard end-to-end with 1 strategy (Hunter) → BTC → 1m/1h → step 4 shows wizard-use-live-toggle+wizard-use-live-switch and toggle text is exactly 'Use my live settings' (tightened copy confirmed). With live OFF the wizard-exit-atr and wizard-exit-fixed cards are selectable (both present). RUN VALIDATION advanced to step 6 and started wizard-running (backtest in flight; UI showed 'Running backtest… hunter · BTC · 1m · 1h · ATR exit'). MOBILE Exit Engine (tab-workspace): ee-live-preflight present with ee-preflight-mode='PAPER · simulation', ee-preflight-connection='Connected · kraken', ee-preflight-size='$150/trade Keep ~$50 for first live', ee-preflight-trading='Active', ee-preflight-trading-action='Kill' (owner action button). ee-preflight-paper NOT rendered because is_live=false (correct — only shown when LIVE). ee-active-exit shows the Universal Exit Engine global default with ee-overrides listing the same 'squeeze · Fixed-% Stop, hunter · ATR Trailing Stop' chips (ee-overrides-empty absent, correctly, because overrides exist). ee-edit-current tap target present. MOBILE Research (tab-research): wizard renders with core strategies visible, wiz-use-live-exit toggle present with 'Use my live settings' copy confirmed, wizard-run present. wiz-exit-atr / wiz-exit-fixed not rendered on the initial view because useLive defaults to ON (segmented only shows when live is OFF, per code /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx L204) — this is correct behavior per spec. PARITY: preflight card, per-strategy exit readout, and Research 'Use my live settings' copy all present and consistent across web + mobile. FINAL STATE (verified via GET /api/environment + /api/settings after all tests): trading_mode=PAPER, is_live=false, ready_to_trade=true, exchange=kraken, manual_kill_switch=FALSE — account safe, no lingering LIVE/STOPPED state.

action_items: None functional — feature ships as spec'd on both surfaces.

Consider: soft-cap of $75 flags normal_lot_usd=150 as 'above' the recommended tier; if $50 real-money testing is the intent, main agent may want to reduce settings.normal_lot_usd to $50 before flipping to LIVE (or surface a quick 'set to $50' button in the preflight-size cell). Purely a nice-to-have polish.
critical_code_review_comments: LivePreflightCard polls /api/environment every 10s but never re-fetches /api/settings on that interval, so if manual_kill_switch or normal_lot_usd is changed elsewhere (e.g. another browser tab, mobile client) the web card's Trading/Size cells only refresh after refresh() is triggered by an owner action. Not a shipping blocker but worth noting for cross-surface parity when both web+mobile are open at once.

PreflightCell testID is derived from the label via `label.toLowerCase()` on mobile (workspace.tsx L698) — matches spec today (Connection/Size/Trading → ee-preflight-connection/size/trading) but is fragile: any future label rename (e.g. 'Broker connection') would silently break the testID. Suggest passing explicit testIDs.

Web soft-cap threshold ($75, LivePreflightCard.jsx L8) is duplicated on mobile as a hard-coded $75 check (workspace.tsx `overCap` computation). If either surface changes the constant they'll drift — worth centralising into shared config.
